name: offlinepdf-mcp
description: 17 local PDF tools (merge, split, OCR, extract text, repair, GST receipts, and more) that Claude can call directly on your machine. Nothing leaves your device.
long_description:
A local Model Context Protocol server exposing OfflinePDF's PDF tools as functions Claude can call directly. Every tool reads a file from disk, does its work in this local Node process, and writes the result back to disk — no network calls, no uploads, no telemetry.

12 tools wrap the offlinepdf-sdk package (merge, split, rotate, organize pages, watermark, page numbers, flatten, header/footer, crop, fingerprint, scan/strip metadata, CSV to PDF). 4 tools are new Node-native implementations written for this server: extract text, OCR (fully offline, bundled English language model), repair PDF (2 of 3 recovery strategies), and a simplified GST point-of-sale receipt generator.

Not included in this version: Encrypt PDF, Remove Password, and Repair PDF's third recovery strategy, all of which depend on a pthread-enabled qpdf WebAssembly build that needs a real Worker environment this server doesn't provide. See the README for the full list of what's excluded and why.

tools.name: merge_pdfs
tools.description: Combine two or more PDF files into one.

tools.name: split_pdf
tools.description: Split a PDF by page ranges, or into one file per page.

tools.name: rotate_pdf
tools.description: Rotate every page of a PDF 90/180/270 degrees.

tools.name: organize_pdf_pages
tools.description: Reorder, rotate, or delete specific pages.

tools.name: watermark_pdf
tools.description: Stamp a text or image watermark on every page.

tools.name: add_page_numbers
tools.description: Add page numbers in a chosen format and position.

tools.name: flatten_pdf
tools.description: Flatten fillable form fields into permanent content.

tools.name: add_header_footer
tools.description: Add a header/footer, optional date and page number.

tools.name: crop_pdf
tools.description: Trim margins, or resize pages to a target size.

tools.name: fingerprint_pdf
tools.description: Stamp a leak-deterrent ID into a PDF.

tools.name: scan_pdf_metadata
tools.description: Scan a PDF for privacy-sensitive metadata.

tools.name: strip_pdf_metadata
tools.description: Remove privacy-sensitive metadata from a PDF.

tools.name: csv_to_pdf
tools.description: Convert a CSV file into a paginated PDF table.

tools.name: extract_pdf_text
tools.description: Extract a PDF's text content, page by page.

tools.name: ocr_pdf
tools.description: OCR a scanned/image-only PDF, fully offline.

tools.name: repair_pdf
tools.description: Repair a damaged PDF (clean rebuild or partial recovery).

tools.name: generate_pos_receipt
tools.description: Generate a simplified GST point-of-sale receipt PDF.
